Successful CI is not an error-free log claim.

privacy.apiFieldSelectionDisclosure: GitHub run and GitLab job public receipts deliberately omit commit author/committer email; full original API bytes and hashes remain under E:/CodexTemp. Other indexed API files and logs are byte-identical originals.
privacy.excluded: No tokens, private keys, player state, device values, server scope, game worlds, Minecraft binaries or class disassembly copied into repository evidence. CI JAR binaries remain cache-only.

limits: CI build/check success is not dedicated-server, graphical-client, multiplayer, anti-cheat accuracy or performance acceptance.
CI JAR hashes describe this Linux rebuild, not the already validated Windows or published release artifacts.
GitLab quota failures mean no job ran on that host; they do not prove build success or source failure.
The first failed Forge 1.19.2 TCP fixture and its REGISTER-format diagnosis belong to separate local server evidence.
